name: VIB Verse
summary:
Here are some key features of VIB Verse app
- Immerse yourself in and experience a virtual banking city with numerous zones dedicated to separate products
- Customize your avatar to appear in VIB Verse
- Convenient and flexible movement
- Easy to access with quick access
- View card information
- Find a card that suits your needs
- Select cards and compare their features
- View the visually engaging car with realistic dimensions 
- Calculate and receive the loan payment details
- View VIB promotions and cam
